notes:
ROUTE: Claude-in-Chrome connector only, one dedicated tab (tabId 1961715027), closed at the end. robots.txt was fetched same-origin from the loaded AE page first: 4054 bytes, 93 Disallow lines under User-agent: *, none of them covering /ae/ or /cat/, no blanket Disallow: /, and no mention anywhere of anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web / Claude-User / Claude-SearchBot. No curl / requests / WebFetch / proxy at any point; every fetch() ran inside the loaded www.ikea.com/ae/en page context. No 403, CAPTCHA, DataDome or rate-limit was seen at any stage - 117 API calls, 12 enumeration+boundary triples, 13 raw page fetches and 3 page loads all returned 200.

TREE SOURCE: script[type=text/hydrate] -> data.config.catalogSlim on https://www.ikea.com/ae/en/cat/furniture-fu001/ (which redirects to /cat/all-furniture-fu001/); the child key is 'subs', as f107 (IKEA DE) established, NOT 'subCategories'. The AE payload has 21 top-level departments and 1579 node instances; 749 of them sit in the eight real furniture departments fu002 Tables & chairs, 700640 Sofas & armchairs, bm001 Beds & mattresses, st001 Storage & organisation, fu004 Desk & desk chairs, ba001 Bathroom products, od001 Outdoor products (od003 Outdoor furniture) and bc001 Baby & children. To satisfy the 'nav under-reports' trap the whole catalogSlim was keyword-swept in English for sofa/armchair/chair/stool/table/desk/bed/wardrobe/cabinet/cupboard/bench/sideboard/shelv/bookcase/dresser/chest/drawer/seat/couch/trolley/vanity/console/nightstand/headboard/ottoman/pouf/futon/daybed; the 40 unique hits outside the eight furniture departments were all table linen (20538, 20541), lamps (10732, 700512, 16281, 700817), clocks (10785), wardrobe scents (58411), fitted-kitchen cabinets, doors and drawer fronts (ka001 METOD / ENHET / KNOXHULT / JAERNBODA), kitchen drawers and drawer organisers (24258, 24257, 700673), kitchen shelves (20678), tablet stands (41068) and desk accessories (10573) - i.e. no furniture node lives outside the eight departments.

QTY METHOD AND THE HEADER CONVENTION - THIS MATCHES f107 (IKEA DE) AND f140 (IKEA FR) DELIBERATELY: for every leaf the figure in qty is productListPage.productCount from sik.search.blue.cdtapps.com/ae/en/product-list-page?category=<id>, fetched from the loaded page. IKEA's rendered listing header is INFLATED BY EXACTLY +1 whenever plannerCount>0, because client-side hydration injects a non-product planner tile. This was MEASURED on the AE store, not assumed: sofas-fu003 productCount 226 / plannerCount 1 / live DOM header '227 items'; vanity-units-20720 productCount 67 / plannerCount 1 / live DOM header '68 items'; control coffee-tables-10716 productCount 44 / plannerCount 0 / live DOM header '44 items'. The server-delivered HTML carries the un-inflated number on both sides of that split: raw same-origin fetches of ten category pages returned p.plp-filter-information__total-count values identical to the API productCount in 10/10 cases, including plannerCount>0 nodes (21959 '30 items', 47386 '10 items'). Only 14 of the 117 AE leaves have plannerCount>0 (versus 82 of 116 on FR), so the AE header differs from qty on 14 rows only. FOLLOWING f107 AND f140 EXPLICITLY: qty is the ENUMERATED PRODUCT COUNT and the header figure is stated inside every evidence string, so whichever convention the orchestrator settles on stays recoverable and IKEA AE is directly comparable with IKEA DE and IKEA FR. The f140 caching caution was watched for and did not recur here: no raw-HTML header disagreed with the API on any of the ten pages checked.

VERIFICATION: (1) full enumeration - /product-list-page/more-products?category=<id>&start=0&end=productCount+30 was run on a 12-leaf sample spanning the whole range (25206=1, 47360=2, 700424=3, 20611=7, 21958=48, 20926=55, 31786=80, 25219=109, 10382=138, fu003=226, 48005=296, 43632=348) and returned exactly productCount tiles with exactly productCount unique itemNoGlobal values in 12/12 cases - unique product IDs, not href counting. (2) boundary test - start=productCount-1 returned exactly 1 item and start=productCount returned 0 items on the same 12 leaves, 12/12 pass, so no total is truncated or padded. The exhaustive 117/117 version of both checks was already run by f107 on the same global platform, so it was sampled here. (3) node identity: unlike the DE/FR responses the AE product-list-page payload does NOT echo category.name/category.url, so identity was confirmed the other way - ten category pages were fetched as raw HTML and their h1 matched the catalogSlim node name exactly in 10/10 cases (all HTTP 200), and the three pages actually loaded in the tab (sofas-fu003 'Sofas', coffee-tables-10716 'Coffee tables', vanity-units-20720 'Vanity units') matched too. No id silently served a parent listing. (4) 63 distinct qty values across 117 leaves spanning 1-348 - no site-wide constant, no suspiciously round display cap. (5) no leaf returned 0.

INDEPENDENCE FROM IKEA DE (f107) AND IKEA FR (f140): IKEA runs one global platform, so 116 of the 117 DE/FR leaf category IDs also resolve on AE; 700441 (Additional wardrobes) is the single sibling node absent from the AE tree, and 31786 Sofa modules is the single AE leaf that neither sibling emits. The AE figures are the AE market's own: Dining Tables DE 92 / FR 86 / AE 61; Sofas DE 274 / FR 227 / AE 226; Beds DE 226 / FR 232 / AE 208; Fitted Wardrobes DE 389 / FR 403 / AE 348; Dining Chairs DE 112 / FR 110 / AE 109; Coffee Tables DE 45 / FR 44 / AE 44. The AE department layout also differs: AE exposes 700417 'Dining furniture', 19141 'Cafe furniture', 30454 'Sideboards, buffets & console tables' and 10705 'Center & end tables' as real hubs, files 20656 Bedside tables under bm001 as well as st004, and puts 48925 Laundry storage under ba003 Bathroom laundry. The AE storefront is English, so every row name below is the AE store's own live label; nothing was translated or copied from the German or French rows. Three AE labels are demonstrably at odds with what the node lists and are flagged individually: 21962 is labelled 'Tables & chairs' but lists outdoor armchairs, 47386 is labelled 'Outdoor sofas' but lists outdoor benches, and 21959 'Lounging & relaxing furniture' lists outdoor sofas. 21967 is labelled just 'Dining sets', identical to the indoor node 19145, so its own slug wording (outdoor-dining-sets) was used for the row name.

STOPPING RULE: stopped above nodes that only split by seat count, size, material or series - 21825 Dining tables -> 2/4/6/8/10 seater, 19145 Dining sets -> sets up to 2/4/6/10 seats, 25219 Dining chairs -> kitchen chairs / upholstered chairs, fu003 Sofas, fu006 Armchairs, 10663 Sofa-beds, 20926 Footstools & pouffes and bm003 Beds. bm003 is kept as a single leaf exactly as f107 and f140 did, so the 208 figure covers the adult bed range; the children's and baby bed nodes (the 18723 branch, 45781 Cots) are emitted separately under the Baby & children branch.

EXCLUDED, and why: the whole named-series layer (46052 series hub; 42245 BROR, 11703 IVAR, 14317 OLAUS under 700440 Garage storage; 49140 SMASTAD and 700789 LASTARE under 18706; 700561 RELATERA under 700414; 700450 bathroom series; 47423 desk systems and 11811 modular desks) - all component listings. Also excluded: mattresses and bed bases (bm002 and its children, 24825 Mattress bases, 24827 Bed slats, 18724 Children's mattresses, 45855 Cot mattresses); bedding and textiles (tl001, tl004, 18730, 18690, 20542 Chair pads); furniture parts, covers and care (10664 Sofa & armchair covers and its 21 series children, 57536 Sofa & armchair cushions & headrests, 31785 Sofa & armchair legs, 30572 Dining table tops & underframes, 25223 Chair covers, 34006 Dining chair underframes & seat shells, 24822 Bed legs, 57280 bed frame covers, 55997 Sliding wardrobe doors, 18775 Children's bed accessories & canopies); standalone storage goods (st007 Small storage & organisers, 10797 storage boxes, 19059 Under bed storage, 20477 Children's clothes & shoes organisation); wall shelving (10398, 20660, 20481, 20615 - Wall Decor's job); bathroom fixtures and mirrors (20723 sinks, 20724 taps, 40690 showers, 30565 worktops, 10555 accessories, 20490 bathroom mirrors, 20498 / 20499 / 49138 mirrors); laundry goods (55004 Laundry accessories, 20601 Laundry baskets, 20602 Drying racks - only 48925 Laundry storage, a cabinet node, is kept); lighting (li001 and 16283 / 10736 / 18773 / 17897); decoration (de001), tableware (kt001), plants and pots (pp001, 31787), toys (18734, 18716), baby care (18701, 31772), picnic and bags (42924, 16248), outdoor non-furniture (17887 Parasols & gazebos, 700349 Outdoor kitchen, 21957 Outdoor flooring, 55998 grill accessories); and the fitted-kitchen tree (ka001). The two furniture nodes IKEA files inside the kitchen/storage trees - 10471 Kitchen islands & trolleys and 16200 Pantry - are reached through fu005 and st002 and ARE included.

OVERLAPS: the AE tree lists many nodes under two or three parents (21825 / 25219 / 22659 / 59245 / 10412 under both 700417 and 700675 / 700676 / 700319 / 30454; 20862 / 20864 / 19143 / 19144 under both the Tables/Chairs hubs and 16244 / 19141; 47386 under both 700319 Benches and 700350 Outdoor seating; 45816 / 18768 / 18769 / 20483 / 45815 / 45782 under both 18767 and bc004 / fu002; 21966 under both 21964 and 700351; 700192 under both od003 and 700191; 21958 under both st001 and od003; 20858 under both fu005 and ba001; 20656 under both bm001 and st004; fu006 under both 700676 and 700640; 47067 / 47070 under both the desk hubs and 55002 Gaming furniture). Each leaf is emitted exactly once, under its most natural parent, so there are no duplicate rows: 117 leaves, 117 distinct category ids, 117 distinct URLs. Grouping rows whose every child is placed elsewhere are not emitted at all: bc004 Children's chairs, 700440 Garage storage, 18706 Children's storage, bc002 / bc003 and ba003 Bathroom laundry.
